rows.medi_said: بدأت شغلي على تـ- تسعة ونص.
rows.why: Clock time needs el-saa3a / el- before the number; Amal only redirected the question (من وين) and let the time form pass.
rows.english: I started my work at nine thirty.

rows.medi_said: خروف is lamb. مرفوف؟ What was What was ground؟
rows.why: He tried معروف / مرفوف for 'ground (meat)' and asked; Amal supplied مفروم. Sheet: 'ground beef | La7meh mafrumeh | لحمة مفرومة'.
Collective/feminine خضرا takes a feminine adjective; he wavered and settled on masculine مختلف, Amal let it pass (my reading).

rows.amal_said: Yeah, we don't say that yesterday. Just yesterday is its own...
rows.why: He put el- on امبارح (after her model نفس من بارح); he self-fixed at 05:37 but Amal then explained the rule out loud - possibly a self-fix (GR-22), kept low.
Telling what happened yesterday he used the present form أجي; Amal recast past أجا and he repeated it.
Came TO my house takes على/عند, not من (from); Amal said أجا على and then سأجا عندي يعني; he repeated أجا على بيتي.

rows.medi_said: Aja andi wu rah bad, um, metakhri.
rows.why: For 'went home / left' Amal recast روّح; she later said راح is عادي but روّح is the better word - borderline 'both fine', kept low.
Answering 'did you like (حبيت) how we practiced', he said حكيتلي (you told me); Amal repeated حبيت - he echoed the wrong verb (could be a mishearing of her question).

rows.medi_said: بتكسر. ما بتكسري. ما، ما بتس-- بتكس،
rows.chat: e7na benfaddel enno inti ma tekserih
rows.why: After بنفضل انه (we prefer that) the verb drops b-; Amal recast ما تكسري and he said ما تكسريه.
rows.english: We prefer that you don't break it

rows.why: 'I broke it' needs the object ending -o on the verb; Amal recast كسرته and he repeated it.
For 'what broke them' (doer + object) he used the n- (get-broken) form انكسروهم/انكسرهم; Amal recast the plain transitive كسرهم.

rows.amal_said: تكسري. What's plural of أشي إشي؟ ... تكسري أشياء.
rows.why: 'things' is plural; Amal asked for the plural of إشي and gave أشياء; he then said تكسري شي, not taking it.
rows.english: Since when do you break things?

rows.why: سنين = years, not teeth; Amal said سنان and asked what سنين is, he answered 'year' and said سنانها.
He blended كسر into the plural of cup (كسرات, a non-word); Amal recast Kasat and he said 'كاسات، that's right'.

rows.medi_said: الولاد عطلوا. ... Fought? Does that make sense? عطلوا? ... الولاد أتلوا
rows.amal_said: قتلهو. They fought who? قتلوا بعض.
rows.why: عطلوا (broke down / took off) for 'fought'; he switched to أتلوا himself (Amal had offered قتلوا at 26:12), so largely a self-fix.
قاتل takes بعض directly (each other), not مع بعض (together); Amal had said قتلوا بعض, he added مع, she restated 'fought each other' and he dropped مع.
'One of the kids' needs من; Amal prompted 'واحد of the children' and he said واحد من ولاد.

rows.amal_said: or of them. One of them.
rows.why: 'of the children' (specific kids) needs el-; Amal redirected to منهم and he later asked 'I can say واحد من الولاد too, right?' - she said yes.
'change my mind' needs the -i (my) ending on رأي; Amal recast رأيي and he repeated it.
Engine wrote رأيك, but Amal prompted 'your mind' and he said it again - he likely said ra2yi (my) and she prompted the -ak ending; low.

rows.medi_said: We should... Okay. احنا كان لازم--
rows.amal_said: we just should. we not should have. we
rows.why: كان لازم means 'should have'; for plain 'we should' Amal said 'we just should, not should have' and he said احنا لازم.
rows.english: We should change the flight time

rows.why: After لازم the verb is a bare present, not past غيّرنا; Amal named the rule 'present. مضارع' (laazem_noun clue).
After لازم the present verb drops its b-; Amal recast نغير and he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: The time of the flight. وقت ال... اه... flight. Oh my God.
rows.why: He could not find طيارة; Amal hinted 'remember car?' (سيارة) and he said طيارة - a didn't-know prompt.

rows.amal_said: very close. بس السيارة، السيارة feminine or masculine؟ غيرت.
rows.why: Feminine subject طيارة needs feminine past تغيرت; Amal asked feminine or masculine and he said تغيرت.

rows.amal_said: Program is masculine. ... Program is not feminine.
rows.why: برنامج is masculine so the verb is تغير; Amal said 'Program is masculine' and he said تغير.
After لازم a bare present verb is needed, not past اتغيروا; Amal recast يتغيروا, he asked 'is that past tense?' and took it.

rows.amal_said: تغير أو تغيري حالك أو حالك. Make it consistent. Make the gender consistent.
rows.why: The negative command to her must be feminine تغيري to match حالِك; Amal named the gender-consistency rule and he said ما تغيري حالك.
He began the idafa with el- on the first word (اليوم); Amal prompted 'Day of the meeting' and he said يوم الاجتماع - could be just a restart.

rows.amal_said: did change. Why did it change? It did change.
rows.why: 'Why did it change' is past; he said present بتغيّر, Amal stressed 'It did change' and he said تغير.
rows.english: Why did the meeting day change?

rows.why: The command 'photograph me' is صوريني, not the present/t-form تصوريني; Amal said 'Again... You photograph me' and he said صوريني.

rows.amal_said: Mm-hmm. That's the error I was talking about. So cam takes singular.
rows.why: After كم the noun is singular; Amal named the rule and he said كم صورة.
rows.english: How many pictures did you take?

rows.why: 'Do you get photographed a lot' needs the t- (get-X) form بتتصوري; Amal recast it and he said 'Oh, that's right, بتتصوري'.
rows.english: Do you get photographed a lot?

rows.amal_said: First do the left, left past. Make it past.
rows.why: Telling a past trip he used the bare لف; Amal said 'Make it past' and he said لما لفيت.
rows.english: When I traveled around the world

rows.medi_said: So you add the E. It's Zakarini.
rows.proposed_rule: When the command has a doubled middle letter plus an ending, drop the short vowel after it: zakkrini, not zakkarini.
rows.why: He kept a full vowel after the doubled middle letter; Amal said 'less e' because the doubled letter sits in the middle of the verb - a sound-shape rule, low.

rows.proposed_rule: 'Remind me to do X' needs the action verb after zakkerni, not the thing alone: zakkrini ajeeb 5ubez.
rows.why: He left out the verb (bring) after 'remind me'; Amal prompted 'To bring' and he added a verb.

rows.amal_said: I bring. ... To bring, but who's bringing? You are bringing.
rows.why: The one bringing is him, so the verb is I-form أجيب, not you-form تجيبي; Amal asked who's bringing and he said أجيب.
For 'I reminded him' he put the you-ending -ak; Amal repeated 'I reminded him' and he moved to Zakaretno, then her Zakarto.
Wrong shape of the him-ending on the I-past (-etno); Amal recast Zakarto and he said زكرته.
'They didn't remember me' needs ما; Amal said 'Didn't' and he said ما تذكّروني.
A habit ('he doesn't remember names') is present with b-; he used the past, Amal recast Ma bietzakar and he said 'Oh, it's present tense'.
Amal replaced his plural أسامي with أسماء (her chat el-asmaa2) - plural pattern; أسامي is also heard in Levantine, so medium.

rows.amal_said: Asma. As it's general, so what do we add? ... Il asma.
rows.why: Names in general take el-; Amal asked what we add, he said 'I don't know', she gave Il asma.

rows.amal_said: الكل؟ ... كل الكلمات؟ كل شي. You could say كل شي.
rows.why: الكل means everyone; for 'everything' Amal questioned الكل and gave كل شي / كل الكلمات, he said كل شي.
rows.english: I want to practice everything a lot
